headline: Building Pocket Dev with Ani | Free, open-source developer tools
about:
I’m building Pocket Dev with my partner Ani to help developers spend less time tied to a desk without losing touch with their work.

Pocket Dev is free and open source. It brings your computer’s terminals, Claude Code and Codex chats, Git and files to your phone’s browser. Your work stays on your own computer, using your existing coding-agent accounts.

Use it on the same Wi-Fi, or configure optional remote access when you’re away. Your computer needs to stay on and awake.
